rules.statement: A lessee has a cause of action against the purchaser of the lessor for being dispossessed otherwise than by process of law, and is entitled to compensation for any damage caused.
rules.supporting_quote: "The plaintiff in this case does not seek possession as being of no value to him. There is no question that he was in possession, and that his possession as a lessee was a bona fide one under his lease. As such he is entitled to compensation for impensae utiles, and, I think, for any damage that may have happened to him by the second defendant company enforcing their right without proceeding in the ordinary course of law."
